styleSelection.reason: The target is a luminous watercolor portrait of a tabby cat and man built from pale warm washes, nested midtone planes, cross-region shadow glazes, and selective sepia line accents.

cat-ears-and-crown.reason: The cat's ears and forehead tabby stripes require pale ochre/sienna base washes followed by nested midtone planes and dry dark ear-interior accents.

cat-eyes-and-muzzle.reason: The cat's luminous green eyes, terracotta nose leather, and reserved white muzzle require crisp dry-edge control around catchlights and eye rings.

cat-cheek-and-neck-fur.reason: Warm golden-ochre and burnt-sienna fur planes transition softly across the cheek and neck into the embrace shadow.

cat-white-chest-and-whiskers.reason: Most of the chest stays clean paper white with delicate warm-grey shadow planes and late closing whisker lines.

human-dark-hair-crown.reason: Keeping precise-watercolor on the hair ensures Band 1 stays a light wash while Bands 2-5 build the deep Payne's-grey and sepia mass without dumping pigment into Band 1 or creating a warm brown perimeter halo.

human-forehead-and-brows.reason: Broad warm flesh washes grade around the reserved forehead highlight into crisp dark eyebrows.

human-eyes-and-nose.reason: The downward-gazing eyes and nose bridge rely on controlled midtone planes, preserved lid catchlights, and late dark accents.

human-cheeks-and-stubble.reason: Warm sienna/ochre cheek planes transition into cool Payne's-grey and sepia lower-face beard shadow.

human-moustache-and-mouth.reason: Layered dark-brown and cool-grey washes build the moustache volume before closing ink defines the mouth crease.

shared-embrace-transition.reason: The core shadow where the cat's head rests against the man's temple is unified by cross-region Band 4 and Band 5 shadow glazes.

right-shoulder-and-collar.reason: Loose lower-edge washes fade naturally into the unpainted paper vignette.

open-paper-vignette.reason: Unpainted white paper margin framing the diagonal composition.

families.cue: Warm sienna and ochre tabby ears with deep sepia/Payne's-grey inner ear hollows and pale ear-tuft highlights.
Round sap-green and ochre irises with reserved catchlights, dark pupil/lid rings, pink-terracotta nose, and white muzzle pads.
Golden ochre, burnt sienna, and olive-brown tabby striping curving across the cheek and neck.
Reserved paper-white chest and lower ruff with subtle warm-grey shadow planes.
Rich neutral-cool dark hair mass built progressively from light foundation through midtone and deep Payne's-grey/sepia shadow glazes.
Warm sienna-ochre forehead planes surrounding a bright reserved highlight above dark arched eyebrows.
Downcast human eyes with upper-lid catchlights, dark lash lines, and a warm-shaded nose bridge and nostril wing.
Warm cheek washes transitioning into cool-grey and sepia lower-face beard shadow.
Deep sepia and Payne's-grey moustache and lip crease.
Warm-to-cool core shadow uniting the cat's neck/back and the side of the man's face.
Soft lower-left wash transition along the cat's lower chest and man's shoulder.
Unpainted white paper background in the upper-right and lower-left corners.
